subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept top-level plugin-owned Control UI entry points as a public plugin SDK and gateway protocol contract after the security blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR creates new plugin-facing API and auth/UI security behavior that will become compatibility surface; code review can identify blockers, but maintainers must choose whether this exact product/API direction should ship or be folded into the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC.

options.title: Sponsor after security repair
options.body: Require opaque iframe sandboxing, fail-closed launch behavior, and current-head browser proof, then proceed with maintainer API review of this PR.

options.title: Fold into the RFC
options.body: Keep the implementation unmerged and move the useful design into the broader Control UI contribution-slot discussion before accepting any public SDK surface.

options.title: Close as unsupported direction
options.body: Close this PR if top-level plugin navigation entries are not a core plugin SDK surface maintainers want to support now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after security repair
recommendation.body: Require opaque iframe sandboxing, fail-closed launch behavior, and current-head browser proof, then proceed with maintainer API review of this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available maintainer routing candidate from current merge/ownership evidence for a cross-cutting plugin SDK, gateway, and security-boundary decision.
